description_en: Checks data protection scoring rules. Calling this operation triggers an asynchronous task to check whether your resources meet the requirements of data protection scoring
description_zh: 检查数据保护评分规则。调用该接口将会触发一个异步任务来检查您的资源是否满足数据保护评分的要求
name: CheckRules

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the resource. Required. You can specify multiple resource ARNs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源唯一标识。必填。支持使用英文逗号（,）分隔传入多个资源ARN
parameters.name: resource_arn

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule to check. If this parameter is not specified, all rules are checked
parameters.help_zh: 需要检查的规则ID，不填代表检查所有规则
parameters.name: rule_id
